$comment: Golden vectors for 'is this order still up for grabs'. Run against src/lib/orderEligibility.ts (npm run test:claimability) and android OrderAlarmWatcherParityTest. The native alarm can only be stopped by Java when Java and the WebView agree on this rule; if they drift, a helper keeps hearing a taken order, or loses the tone on a live one.

cases.name: fresh pending order with no helper is claimable
pending but already taken by a helper
pending with an empty helperId is still unclaimed
pending with a whitespace helperId is still unclaimed
accepted order is not claimable
on-the-way order is not claimable
delivered order is not claimable
cancelled order is not claimable
CANCELLED spelling is not claimable
completed order is not claimable
approved cancellation request removes it
an ACCEPTED cancellation state is not a status this app writes, so it does not remove the order
requested cancellation does not remove it
rejected cancellation does not remove it
unknown status is not claimable
missing status is not claimable
shop order pending is claimable
shop order has no helperId of its own
shop order accepted by the store is not claimable
shop order cancelled by the store is not claimable
shop order delivered is not claimable
shop order is decided by its own status alone
shop order with an unknown status is not claimable
